diagnostics.root_cause: The SDK runtime QA CLI resolves frozen acceptance identity from absent top-level fields instead of the nested acceptance_ledger object.

candidates.name: construction-profile liveness boundary
candidates.deterministic_replay: The same deadline, artifact, and readiness history yields the same liveness classification.
candidates.failure_semantics: Keep unresolved or invalid construction visible without suppressing the best legal deliverable or official scoring.
candidates.counterevidence: Method v8 already substantially states this non-gating boundary.
candidates.falsifier: No distinct normative or observable delta can be stated relative to v8.

candidates.name: machine-readable Corridor authoring contract
candidates.deterministic_replay: The same SDK version and capsule produce byte-identical starter bytes and schema description.
candidates.side_effects: Writes only the requested new authoring directory.
candidates.failure_semantics: Return uncompiled or a typed schema error; never imply task readiness.
candidates.saving_estimate: Observed 494-663 second pre-edit interval is an upper bound only because task reading is included.
candidates.counterevidence: A starter and CLI help already exist; discovery or prompting may be the actual gap.
candidates.falsifier: Fresh tasks show no reduction in SDK-source reads or time to first meaningful edit under a frozen comparison.

candidates.name: validate-all and identity-join report
candidates.deterministic_replay: Identical bytes and expected identities produce identical canonical JSON.
candidates.failure_semantics: Typed errors remain non-gating for external task execution and scoring.
candidates.saving_estimate: May replace 3-9 validator command groups; no wall-time estimate is supported.
candidates.counterevidence: Separate validators may be intentional and more actionable.
candidates.falsifier: The aggregate report hides errors, diverges from component semantics, or does not reduce commands and rework.

candidates.name: bounded coupled-witness envelope
candidates.deterministic_replay: The same canonical inputs and domain observations produce the same envelope; the SDK does not invent domain truth.
candidates.failure_semantics: Unknown or unresolved with witness; never authority, PASS, or task mutation.
candidates.saving_estimate: Not estimable; only schema and join reuse is hypothesized.
candidates.counterevidence: Witness-generation algorithms showed negligible cross-domain code overlap.
candidates.falsifier: The envelope requires task-specific semantics or falsely treats finite witnesses as universal proof.

candidates.name: single QA semantic owner
inputs: frozen Rule, Acceptance, and freeze identities
candidates.deterministic_replay: Identical bytes and identities have identical meaning at producer, CLI, and harness intake.
candidates.failure_semantics: not_assessed with typed witness; external scoring continues.
candidates.saving_estimate: No Builder-time claim; avoids divergent repair and diagnosis.
candidates.counterevidence: The normative parser is already single-owned by corridor_kit.acceptance::load_qa_json_text.
candidates.falsifier: An intake surface independently parses normative QA bytes or assigns different meaning to identical joined inputs.

candidates.name: nested freeze identity resolver
outputs: one canonical acceptance identity view for CLI and harness
candidates.deterministic_replay: Identical assessment and freeze bytes produce identical validation decisions across intake surfaces.
candidates.failure_semantics: Malformed or missing identity returns not_assessed with typed errors and never blocks official scoring.
candidates.saving_estimate: No time saving claimed; this is semantic conformance.
candidates.counterevidence: Only one retained occurrence has been replayed.
candidates.falsifier: After repair, a nested, flat, malformed, or legacy freeze is interpreted differently by CLI and harness under the declared compatibility contract.

candidates.name: latest structurally-valid Builder handoff
candidates.deterministic_replay: The same event history selects the same latest structurally-valid artifact while preserving separate readiness and deliverability states.
candidates.side_effects: Append-only snapshots and telemetry plus runner-owned restore.
candidates.failure_semantics: Report absence of a structurally-valid snapshot and continue with the best legal official deliverable; never manufacture PASS.
candidates.saving_estimate: The 0.594 versus 1773.850 second same-artifact replay is a contaminated upper-bound diagnostic only.
candidates.counterevidence: An unresolved artifact may be structurally valid, so one latest-valid bit is ambiguous.
candidates.falsifier: Fresh tasks still lose Worker time or early handoffs increase invalidity without improving the declared mechanism.

candidates.name: automatic construction telemetry
candidates.deterministic_replay: The same event stream produces the same canonical report.
candidates.failure_semantics: Missing telemetry stays explicit and is never replaced with an invented zero.
candidates.saving_estimate: Audit reconstruction time only; no task-efficacy claim.
candidates.counterevidence: Most raw data already exists, so this may be only a reporting adapter.
candidates.falsifier: The summary cannot be joined to source event IDs and digests.

candidates.name: release, provenance, and source-map audit primitives
candidates.deterministic_replay: Pinned tree, toolchain, and policy yield a canonical report.
candidates.failure_semantics: Typed finding or unresolved result; root input remains unchanged.
candidates.saving_estimate: No cross-task estimate is justified from one observation.
candidates.counterevidence: Only one task and domain; later verifier feedback existed.
candidates.falsifier: A second unseen release task requires embedded task IDs, private indicators, expected failures, or fixtures.

candidates.name: public record and document evidence survey
candidates.deterministic_replay: A pinned public world snapshot yields canonical facts.
candidates.side_effects: Scratch and cache only; no portal mutation.
candidates.failure_semantics: Unavailable or ambiguous source with provenance.
candidates.saving_estimate: Not estimable from one domain observation.
candidates.counterevidence: Most of the large adapter was task-specific.
candidates.falsifier: A second record or document task requires warranty-specific policy or endpoint assumptions.

candidates.name: MusicXML structural inspection
candidates.deterministic_replay: Pinned bytes and parser version yield a canonical report.
candidates.failure_semantics: Unsupported or ambiguous musical semantics remain unresolved.
candidates.saving_estimate: Not estimable from one domain observation.
candidates.counterevidence: The observed adapter encoded task-specific harmonic judgments.
candidates.falsifier: Parser and structural mechanics fail on a second unseen task without task-specific semantic additions.

candidates.side_effects: Specified separately by each frozen task adapter.
